name: vscode-claude-statusline
description: Editor stats and live Claude Code session usage (model, tokens, cost, context %) in the VS Code status bar.

claudeStatusline.enabled.description: Show the Claude Code session status bar item.

claudeStatusline.pollIntervalMs.description: How often to re-check the transcript file in addition to the file watcher, in milliseconds.

claudeStatusline.contextWindowTokens.description: Context window size (in tokens) used to estimate the context-usage percentage shown in the status bar.

claudeStatusline.sessionFile.description: Absolute path to a specific Claude Code .jsonl transcript to track. Leave empty to auto-detect the most recently modified session for the current workspace under ~/.claude/projects/.

claudeStatusline.pricing.description: USD price per 1,000,000 tokens, keyed by model id, e.g. { "claude-sonnet-5": { "inputPerMillion": 3, "outputPerMillion": 15, "cacheWritePerMillion": 3.75, "cacheReadPerMillion": 0.3 } }. No defaults are shipped — verify current Anthropic pricing before configuring, since the extension does not fetch or guess rates. Without an entry for a model, cost shows as n/a.
